global_caption: The video consists of 10 shots and features a medieval magical castle piano solo in a low-saturation watercolor illustration style. The overall color palette blends cool gray-blue and beige-gold tones, with soft lighting and side lighting unifying the visual composition. The emotional tone remains consistently calm and focused.

A girl child runs from the depths of the corridor toward the Slightly blurred foreground columns enhance depth, while soft light from side windows and faint candle shadows on the wall outline her silhouette. The camera moves forward slightly along the corridor with subtle follow motion, establishing the castle space and the momentum of rushing to perform.

A slightly blurred corner of the Wood grain and metal hinges appear warm and soft under the low-saturation watercolor texture. The camera maintains the overhead angle but performs a very short slide, emphasizing the cautious precision of the test note.

Composition places her face on the right, with blurred left side still showing rising and falling hands and a few keys, creating dual focus on expression and motion. Soft light wraps around her cheeks, side light outlines eyelashes and nose bridge. The camera slowly pushes in, drawing viewers into her internal rhythmic control.
shot10: Shot 10 cuts hard back to a wide eye-level shot, fully presenting the Stone walls, side window, candlelight, piano, and the girl child seated before it all return to a unified fairy-tale composition. A small amount of empty space in the foreground allows the echo to seem to have a place to rest. As the final note is pressed, her fingers stabilize and her wrist slowly relaxes. After the key rebounds, the entire room briefly freezes. Echoes gently spread and fade between stone walls. Candle shadows continue to flicker. Only the final sustain extends to the end. The camera extremely slowly pulls back and holds still for the last half second, letting the closing resonance naturally settle into the air of the castle.
